scope: Osteoarticular tuberculosis and fungal arthritis, from two open reviews stored together.

keyRecommendations.text: Questions on mycobacterial arthritis use only the bone-and-joint tuberculosis review.
Questions on fungal arthritis use only the fungal arthritis review.

clinicalBottomLine: Osteoarticular infection that is mycobacterial or fungal is diagnosed from the joint and bone findings in these two reviews, not from an ICU invasive-fungal definition set.
notableCaveats: The tuberculosis series is dominated by spinal disease (77.6%). That figure is reported as written and is not generalised to every joint. Drug-resistance percentages describe the analysed strains in that paper.
